protocol.scope: Complete contiguous BHSD D64 forward and forward-plus-backward calls; geometry resident.
protocol.arithmetic: docs/precision.md unchanged; compare mathematical FP64 and rounded-reference diagnostics separately.
protocol.baseline: C32 all owners, materialize_output_grads=True reproduces the prior two unused statistic-gradient fills.
protocol.hypothesis: C64 reduces repeated traversal/load/barrier work; per-owner tests isolate changed tiles, while no_stat_fills removes unused autograd operations.
protocol.sample_order: Rotating and alternating variant order for paired rounds.
protocol.host_scope: Eager intervals include explicit experiment selection controls for all variants; graph replay uses fixed captured kernels.
protocol.graph_validation: Changed Q/K/V/dO against fresh eager under the identical variant context; operands restored.
protocol.accuracy: Per-head sampled mathematical FP64 norm error: FP16 0.5%, BF16 1%; rounded diagnostics use actual rounded O.
protocol.exact_equivalence: When baseline is selected it qualifies first; same-C32 no_stat_fills must match every O/dQ/dK/dV byte, including signed zero. Other variants record full-tensor equality without a bitwise gate. Omitted baseline is explicit missing validation.
protocol.resource_scope: Compiler cubin/PTX, register/shared-memory/spill data must be retained by the campaign wrapper; staging estimates are not measured resources.
